answer: The karst cap is applied at intake and dune makes public the per-origin counts. A datacenter or proxy pool therefore cannot mint a farm in one epoch whatever the capital it holds, as each account consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. At most 1 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a thread tag. That is 23 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
